relation: Dv f_u + Du g_v > 2 sqrt(Du Dv det J)  (diffusion-driven instability)
note: The DDI condition for the linearisation about a homogeneous steady state, under the law's named hypotheses (positive diffusivities, trace J < 0, det J > 0). 'violated' here means the committed Jacobian and diffusivities do NOT give a Turing instability; it says nothing about whether any pattern forms in an organism.
